head_note: head = last code commit before this file; the file is committed on top of it.

c02_stats_pair.note: 256-lane fixed halving tree, two streams per barrier; StandardScaler mean pass only (finite input).

c02_linear_pair.note: row-block x column exact integer accumulation + incumbent cs_fold_kernel; bits_change assumed until the ID check.

c05_phase_scratch.note: host arena offset planning only. Board @report workloads currently raise in the adapter (metric_workloads.py:58, report settings pending) before any report: NOT MEASURABLE until that is fixed.

c05_ols_phase.note: UNREACHED: classical:ols takes the TSQR route (x_decomp/api.mojo:585 IDN_OLS_ONE_ENTRY) and never calls ols_fit; :208 is FAST-Apple only, :340 weighted only.

c14_group_rhs.note: Reach fixed (catalog narrowed): grouping only acts on lu-solve (64 RHS; trs_group_kernel, 16 active threads replacing cell-parallel trs_diag_kernel: expected loser). ridge-clf (binary, T=1) and the ridge-cv REFIT reach t_ridge_solve_best with count=1 (no grouping). The RidgeCV fold solve kf_solve_kernel (x_linear/device.mojo:3444) has one RHS per (fold, alpha) factor, so RHS grouping cannot apply there; the ridge-cv speedup is C13 (review section 3). ridge.mojo:195 and cells.mojo:1534 are host-only.

c15_factor_solve.note: ARD only; lead thread does a fixed-order dk triangular solve.

c16_glm_fused.note: removes one launch per GLM iteration; one thread per row.

c17_ls_trials.note: switches qn line search to 2 speculative trials accepted in original order; logreg-cv NOT reached (own L-BFGS).

c17_ovr.note: UNREACHED on the board: SGD minibatch one-vs-rest with >1 problem only; board sgd-clf is binary.

c19_sgd_chunk.note: UNREACHED on the board: every SGD-family estimator defaults to the minibatch route (_sgd_mb_grid): SGDClassifier/Regressor batch 4096, Perceptron/PA 256, SGDOneClassSVM 4096 in IDENTICAL. SGD_PS_CHUNK only affects batch_size=0 fits. Compiled (rc=0) at 79aa4a19c for sm_89 OFF and =32 before the no-compile rule.

c20_row_cache.note: SHAPE VIOLATION: host loop over the n_ws (1024) working-set rows, 3 launches per row (~3072 serialized launches per SMO iteration) including a grid=1/block=1 publish kernel (kernelcache.mojo:337), and a full n_rows kernel row per row (10x the n_ws^2 tile work). Returns early, so it MASKS c20_pair_load (square tile site) and c22_triangle. Expected loser by construction; recommend delete without a run.

c20_pair_load.note: fused row+norm gather, parallel over n_ws*n_cols, no reduction.

c21_extrema.note: 4-way shared-memory extrema tree under a total (value,key) order (in-block TPB=256 and cross-block). Skips the SAB_FMAX_HWMAX sabotage arms.

c22_triangle.note: fires only for the SMO square tile (m==n, same pointer); n*n grid with half idle, classical_dot fixed leaf tree. Not reached by kernel-ridge, kernel-pca, ocsvm (catalog claims removed).

c29_stream_topk.note: SHAPE VIOLATION: one thread per query, serial over ALL n_index rows with O(k) insertion (classical:knn: 4k threads x 400k candidates x (d+64)); replaces the tiled distance + selection + fixed partial merge. Gate is `C29_STREAM_TOPK or C30_DIRECT_DISTANCE`, so C30 (lane L1) alone also turns it on. Expected loser by construction.

c29_tile.note: pure column-loop chunking; meaningful only with c29_stream_topk (or C30) on.

c52_pair_rows.binding: _mojolearn_estimators (+ _mojolearn_estimators_host: build the host column with the same define)
c52_pair_rows.note: leaf 256 -> 128|512 and pair_parts combine tree; host oracle follows the same define.

c58_shared_prep.note: per-series scale computed once instead of by every thread of every start block; exact power-of-2 scale.

c58_series4.note: UNREACHED on the board: serial estimate arm only (frequency + 5 > HW_EST_BLOCK=64); board ets uses seasonal_periods=24.

c58_forecast4.note: 4 series per thread: 64 series -> 16 threads in one block; 4x less parallelism, likely slower. garch does NOT reach it (team_kernel).

c58_team_mib.note: memory budget; at board size (64 series, prophet ~13.6 MB, garch ~6.8 MB) G=64 either way: no-op.

c59_trial_state.note: one observation copy instead of N+1; indexing only.

c60_lag4.note: 4 adjacent cells per thread, ascending per-cell sums; autoarima d=0 round only (max_d=1).

c61_same_component_skip.note: NEW (this lane, NOT COMPILED): in sparse_mr_search_tiled_kernel (NV/AMD default arm) skip a j tile when every listed point of the block and every j of the tile share one component; those cells are already excluded by the epilogue (cj != ci), so outputs are identical. Block-uniform flag via two barriers; per-block uniform-component scan is one thread over the fixed SMR_TI (not a runtime size). Gain depends on later Boruvka rounds; unmeasured.

arima_search_reuse.note: EXISTING define (name says FAST but it is gated only on ARIMA_ORDER_BATCH, which is on under IDENTICAL on every vendor). AutoARIMA adopts the order search fit instead of refitting; aic/bic come from the device ic kernel (lane arima-ics). Apple FAST: taxi-hourly 16386 -> 9872 ms. Must confirm IDENTICAL outputs equal the refit (ID check) before keeping.
